description: This file defines the API for accessing BDF-specific strings in the FreeType font rendering library, including enums, structures, and function declarations related to BDF font properties.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Charset_ID
methods.description: Retrieves the charset ID, encoding, and registry for a BDF font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Property
methods.description: Retrieves a specific BDF property from a font face.
